fullPassage: Dear Professor Sanchez, My name is Ellis Wight, and I'm the director of the Alexandria Science Museum. We are holding a Chemistry Fair for local middle school students on Saturday, October 28. The goal of the fair is to encourage them to be interested in science through guided experiments. We are looking for college students who can help with the experiments during the event. I am contacting you to ask you to recommend some students from the chemistry department at your college who you think are qualified for this job. With their help, I'm sure the participants will have a great experience. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Sincerely, Ellis Wight

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① are → is: 주어가 The goal(단수)이므로 is
det.analysis:
✅ ① fair are → fair is: 'The goal of the fair are to encourage' — 주어는 The goal(단수)이고 of the fair는 수식어구이므로 동사는 is가 맞음. are는 수 일치 오류 ← 정답

❌ ② looking: 'We are looking for' — 현재진행형, 정상

❌ ③ recommend: 'ask you to recommend' — to부정사, 정상

❌ ④ qualified: 'are qualified for this job' — 형용사 보어, 정상
det.tip: 주어 핵심어 The goal(단수) + is. of the fair는 수식어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: interest(동사/명사) → interested(과거분사): 주어 them(사람)이 감정을 느끼므로 과거분사 interested가 필요하다. interesting(현재분사)은 흥미를 유발하는 쪽을 나타낸다.
det.tip: 감정동사: 사람 주어 + -ed(interested). interest → interested

questions.passage: Dear Professor Sanchez, My name is Ellis Wight, and I'm the director of the Alexandria Science Museum. We are holding a Chemistry Fair for local middle school students on Saturday, October 28. The goal of the fair is to encourage them to be interested in science through guided experiments. We are looking for college students who can help with the experiments during the event. I am contacting you to ask you to recommend some students from the chemistry department at your college who you think are qualified for this job. With their help, I'm sure the participants will have a great experience. I __________. Sincerely, Ellis Wight
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 영어로 쓰시오. (영어로)
우리말: 저는 당신으로부터 곧 소식 듣기를 고대합니다.
[조건] (1) forward, from, hearing, look, soon, to, you를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.analysis: 본문: 'I look forward to hearing from you soon' — look forward to의 to는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사 hearing이 와야 한다. 부사 soon이 뒤에서 수식한다.
det.tip: look forward to + -ing = ~하기를 고대하다 (to는 전치사)
